item: check --build: GenerateDepsFile IOException between parallel builds (moq4)
notes: Trial 66 follow-up and trial 67: bro check --build's Debug build of moq4 failed once each time with MSB4018 GenerateDepsFile 'The process cannot access the file .../src/Moq.Sdk/bin/Debug/netstandard2.0/Moq.Sdk.deps.json because it is being used by another process', and the comparison with a copy of HEAD then said 'the Debug build failed where the untouched code's didn't' (Not clean, exit 2) on a race, not a finding. To do: find which builds run at once (Moq.Sdk is built through several project references with different global properties), and retry a build whose only errors are such a file lock, or build the configurations one after the other.
